priority_basis: Tier 0 local proofs; 1 four goal-credit conflicts with direct scoring consequences; 2 minute band changes and other explicit conflicts; 3 missing evidence; 4 candidate-invariant conflicts. Action summary within tiers is sorted by affected population, not estimated success.

proof_requirements.qualify_sparse_counter_semantics_or_comp: Document omission semantics for the exact source version, field and season, or reconstruct from independently complete event inventories. Two omitted fields do not verify zero.
proof_requirements.reconcile_stat_conflict: Check raw payloads, timestamps/revisions and metric definitions. Preserve conflicting values; do not select source by order.
proof_requirements.reconcile_goal_credit_conflict: Obtain official goal-credit/revision evidence and distinguish original FPL scoring from later event adjudication. Audit linked own-goal and assist credits before choosing a historical target policy.
proof_requirements.complete_goal_assist_adjudication: Exhaustive goal/candidate coverage, verified receiving/touch/intent facts and supported rule route; new frozen holdout controls before historical approval.
proof_requirements.obtain_remaining_keeper_evidence: Use the existing 38-row request and approved bounds; explicit big-chance/blocked-shot evidence or verified keeper counter. No xG proxy.
proof_requirements.reconcile_minutes_scoring_band_change: Verify participation and official FPL versus provider minute conventions at zero, 60 and >60. Candidate span does not prove which source is right.
proof_requirements.minutes_same_candidate_scoring_bands: Retain source conflict; deprioritize minute-component review only. Clean sheets, goals conceded and complete labels are separate.
proof_requirements.passes_same_candidate_bps_band: Retain raw conflicts; equal output across valid recorded combinations is conditional on source candidates and qualified pass formula.
proof_requirements.apply_documented_winner_zero_supplement: Official final result is a draw or loss; all explicit winner counters checked for contradictions. Supplement remains separate from locked labels.
proof_requirements.penalty_split_irrelevant_to_scoring: Historical roster position GK/DEF gives 12 BPS for either goal type. Leave penalty count unknown; total goals and other components still require resolution.

new_source_search_policy: Use the existing 21 missing-match, three missing-event-match and 38 keeper queues; do not repeat previously documented blocked or exhausted sources.
